title: CovertComBench: The First Domain-Specific Testbed for LLMs in Wireless Covert Communication

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing model responses to multiple-choice questions to identify semantic misalignment, specifically observing whether models improperly conflate wireless 'Covert Communication' with multimedia 'Steganography'.

Evaluating mathematical derivations and problem-solving steps to observe if models disproportionately prioritize maximizing utility (e.g., transmission rate) while neglecting strict security and covertness constraints.
